research_mode: official UK government and ONS primary statistical releases and methodology only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel result, exact incident location, candidate value, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.name: TACT release coverage
verified_claims: The release covers police powers under terrorism and subsequent legislation in Great Britain up to 31 March 2026.
limitations: The release does not provide parcel-level or exact-location risk evidence.

sources.name: TACT administrative revision boundary
verified_claims: The statistics draw on administrative sources that are updated as cases progress and may be revised in future releases.
limitations: Current outcomes must not be treated as final while cases remain open.

sources.name: TACT annual arrests total
verified_claims: There were 3,061 arrests for terrorism-related activity in the year ending 31 March 2026.
limitations: The total was strongly affected by a specific proscription and is not a stable local-risk baseline.

sources.name: Palestine Action linked arrests
verified_claims: Of the 3,061 arrests, 2,819 were linked to supporting Palestine Action after proscription on 5 July 2025.
limitations: The linked category must be separated from other terrorism-related arrests for comparison.

sources.name: Other terrorism-related arrests
verified_claims: Excluding Palestine Action-linked arrests, there were 242 arrests, 1.7% more than the previous year.
limitations: The small change must not be confused with the increase in the all-arrest total.

sources.name: Latest-quarter terrorism arrests
verified_claims: There were 44 non-Palestine-Action arrests in January to March 2026, 32% fewer than the previous quarter.
limitations: Quarterly volatility does not establish a persistent local trend.

sources.name: Charge outcome snapshot
verified_claims: At the data-provision date, 551 arrests had resulted in a charge.
limitations: The charge rate can change as unresolved cases progress.

sources.name: Arrests involving minors
verified_claims: Forty-one people aged 17 and under were arrested in the year ending March 2026.
limitations: Age-group counts do not support prediction about an individual or parcel.

sources.name: TACT case-position date
verified_claims: Case outcomes were based on the latest recorded position supplied by CTPHQ on 5 May 2026.
limitations: Later releases may show different outcomes for the same arrest cohort.

sources.name: Terrorism-related trials
verified_claims: Seventy-two persons were tried for terrorism-related offences in the year ending March 2026.
limitations: Trial-date statistics are not directly comparable with arrest-cohort statistics.

sources.name: Terrorism-connected custody
verified_claims: There were 273 persons in custody for terrorism and terrorism-connected offences at 31 March 2026.
limitations: The custody snapshot is a national stock measure, not a local incident measure.

sources.name: MPS section 43 searches
verified_claims: The Metropolitan Police Service carried out 98 section 43 stop and searches in the year ending March 2026.
limitations: This MPS count must not be generalised to every police force or parcel.

sources.name: Other-force section 43 searches
verified_claims: Other police forces in England and Wales reported 108 section 43 searches for the first time as statistics in development.
limitations: The new coverage creates a comparability break with earlier MPS-only data.

sources.name: MPS arrests after section 43 search
verified_claims: Sixteen arrests resulted from MPS section 43 stop and searches in the year ending March 2026.
limitations: The arrest rate is based on small counts and is not a parcel-risk probability.

sources.name: Other-force arrests after section 43 search
verified_claims: Twenty-two arrests resulted from section 43 searches by other police forces in England and Wales.
limitations: These statistics are in development and require explicit quality qualification.

sources.name: Delayed solicitor access
verified_claims: There were 14 instances in January to March 2026 where access to a solicitor was delayed.
limitations: The count is an operational-process measure, not a crime-prevalence measure.

sources.name: Officer-recorded ethnic appearance
verified_claims: Ethnic appearance is recorded by the arresting officer and uses the ONS 18+1 classification.
limitations: Officer-observed ethnicity is not equivalent to self-defined ethnicity.

sources.name: Palestine Action arrest outcomes
verified_claims: Of 2,819 linked arrests, 484 were charged, 36 released without charge, 12 had alternative action and 2,287 were bailed or released under investigation.
limitations: Open outcomes must not be summed as final disposals.

sources.name: TACT arrest legislation split
verified_claims: Forty arrests were under section 41 of TACT 2000 and 3,021 were under other legislation.
limitations: Other legislation includes non-terrorism statutes, so statute and terrorism-related classification are distinct.

sources.name: Principal-offence counting rule
verified_claims: Where a person is charged with multiple offences at the same time, the statistics count the most serious offence.
limitations: Charge statistics count people under a principal-offence rule, not every charge laid.
